title: NNNC framework switches: C2 ATR take-profit and the reversion regime gate on four NNNC models
label: PROVISIONAL -- values were chosen on SimpleTrigger trades over these same 2023-26 folds; this tests carry-over to model entries, not out-of-sample value

ARO.control_note: arm D after the 029 merge, run 2026-10-12, = baseline 15/15; predates this file by design

rule.gain: sum of per-fold return_pct, arm minus its control, over a half
rule.per_model_PASS: early gain > 0 AND late gain > 0 AND paired verdict (15 folds) maps to pass AND both risk verdicts (Sharpe, maxDD; 15 folds) map to pass
rule.per_model_INCONCLUSIVE: control < min_control_trades, OR the arm changed trades in 0 folds, OR a mapped verdict is inconclusive
rule.switch_ADOPT: PASS on the primary model (ARO) AND PASS on at least replications_needed of GBR, GFM, MLX
rule.combination: only if both switches are ADOPTED; not run otherwise

reported_only: native controls vs their older records (trades_hash agreement)
